en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhamammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the contracted slave. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is allowed upon him whatever is stipulated upon him’.
